description: Rae language lexical summary for syntax highlighters

format.authority: rae format (compiler/src/rae_format.c); `rae format --rules --json` prints these from the binary
format.verticalLists: one item per line, two spaces deeper, no commas, closing delimiter at the opener's indent
format.blankLines: at most one where the source had one, never at the start of a block
format.comments: wrapped at 100 columns at a space when prefixed `# `; lines with no break point and `#`-without-space lines copied verbatim
format.buildPreflight: rae run / build / watch format the source closure in place first; RAE_FORMAT=check or --check-format refuse and fail; RAE_FORMAT=off skips

notes: Whitespace is insignificant; no semicolons. Use `=` for value copy, `=>` for alias binding (mod/view).
